lastSession.summary: M4.10 baseline evaluation (DQN vs Fixed) — MIXED result, M4 NOT advanced. src/rl/dqnTraining.ts: evaluateDqnVsFixed(model, scenario, evalSeeds) runs DQN(greedy) + Fixed per eval seed (common random numbers). src/rl/dqnBaseline.test.ts: harness test (train->eval on disjoint seeds, valid summaries, same demand) — no win assertion (stochastic init, R8). MEASURED (balanced-4x4-v1, 24 episodes ~13s, eval seeds 51001/2/3 disjoint from train 41021..): DQN avgWait 4.73s vs Fixed 12.19s (-61%), p95 17.2 vs 38.2 (-55%), BUT throughput 399 vs 587 (-32%), maxQueue 6 vs 4, switches 2963 vs 1248 — the DQN cuts waiting but regresses throughput via over-switching (R2 trade-off; low avgWait partly because fewer trips complete). Direction consistent across all 3 eval seeds. Exit criteria: non-blocking (M4.7), tensor-leak-0, eval seed fixed, train/eval seed separated, model snapshot (M4.8) all MET; 'improvement vs Fixed' only PARTIAL (waiting improved, throughput regressed). Per AI_AGENT_GUIDE + R2, M4 stays ACTIVE (no self-advance). Reward (D-017) unchanged; changing it needs a new ADR. npm run check PASS (42 files, 274 tests, build ok). golden/metricVersion unchanged. M4.1-M4.10 all implemented.
